facts.fact: Techeconomy reports the Edo State Office of the Head of Service held a one-day workshop training more than 70 e-governance champions from MDAs on the Edo Cloud platform (sub-national government).

Techeconomy reports the Edo State Government decided to develop a fully state-owned e-governance platform, Edo Cloud, that it says guarantees data sovereignty and unrestricted backend access, rolling out in phases (state level, not national).
Techeconomy quotes the Edo State ICT Agency's head of IT infrastructure saying Edo Cloud is fully designed, built and maintained within the state, with upgrades by in-house teams.
Techeconomy quotes the Edo State ICT Agency saying Edo Cloud is fully designed, built and maintained within the state's technology ecosystem, with no contractor named.
